digest.component_or_area: plan structure validation and deterministic readiness gates
propositions: Empty or whitespace-only joined bodies in Acceptance Criteria checkboxes must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) appearing as values in active execution sections must fail both clarity and P1 gates when not suppressed by same-line negation terms
Sentinel matching must ignore code blocks (fenced and inline) and prose mentions, firing only when sentinels follow line starts, bullets, colons, equals signs, or specific trigger words
Same-line presence of removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) must suppress sentinel failures for that line
Shared deterministic plan-structure parser must enforce clarity floors identically across standalone clarity check and plan-review P1 readiness without changing ticket-type exemptions

Implementation must pass all 25 focused clarity-floor unit tests, 142 existing direct-consumer and plan-review tests, lint, typecheck, and full repository test suite without source changes during verification
